rules.because: no randomised coverage above dpd 365; observed phone nets -3.3 after currency 6 cost at this balance, sms is breakeven; discount 0 because randomised sms recovery declines with discount

extrapolated: no randomised rows above dpd 365, but observed covariates are balanced across channels there and phone recovers 130 net vs ~2 for sms; 0.5 matches both the historical deep-dpd practice and the identified pattern of optimal discount rising with dpd
randomised: at bal<500 early band sms net 28.1 ties phone net 26.9 (within SE); sms is 60x cheaper, and sms recovery is maximised at discount 0
randomised phone dominates (net 528 vs sms 386); recovered amount is highest at discount 0 (621 vs 405 at 0.5) — fresh delinquents pay without concession
randomised mid band: phone net 1168 vs sms 994; recovery peaks at disc 0.1 (1388±79 vs 1349±117 at 0, falling to 914 at 0.5)
randomised 91-180: phone recovery peaks at 0.1-0.2 (846±50 at 0.2 vs 777±73 at 0 and 545 at 0.5); holds for balances >=2k too (1335±81)
randomised 181-365: phone net 480 vs sms 227; recovery peak at disc 0.3 (307±26 vs 283±37 at 0); optimal concession rises with depth

default.because: safety net (rules above cover the dpd space); phone is the randomised-best channel in every tested segment and 0.2 is a middle-of-curve discount

identified: phone > sms > whatsapp in net value for all dpd <= 365, all balance buckets >= currency 500, all products and fatigue levels (n = 89k randomised rows per channel, gaps many SEs wide)
sms recovery is maximised at discount 0 and declines monotonically with discount

phone optimal discount rises with dpd: ~0 at <=30, ~0.1 at 31-90, ~0.2 at 91-180, ~0.3 at 181-365 (peaks identified within ~1 SE of neighbours; the channel choice, not the exact notch, carries most of the value)
at bal<500 and dpd<=90 sms and phone are statistically tied net of cost, so cheap sms is preferred
phone remains strongly positive net even under high contact fatigue (net 128 at fatigue>2.3) and at balances 250-2000 for dpd 91-365
extrapolated: everything at dpd > 365: zero randomised coverage; phone-with-0.5 rests on observed data where channel assignment appears balanced on observables (identical balance/fatigue distributions across channels), but selection on unobservables cannot be excluded
the sms fallback at dpd>365 and bal<250 is a judgment call between two roughly-zero-value options (sms vs none); observed data is confounded there
the value of 'none' is never identified anywhere (it was never explored); I assume contacting weakly dominates given phone's large randomised margins, but cannot prove it for any segment
actions outside the logged channels have zero logged observations; I cannot value them, so I avoid them entirely rather than risk invalid actions
